action.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT vendor_id, strftime(bill_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(amount) AS total FROM ap_bills WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND bill_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND bill_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY vendor_id, strftime(bill_date, '%Y-%m')) SELECT COUNT(*) AS vendor_count FROM (SELECT vendor_id FROM m WHERE total > 3000 GROUP BY vendor_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ym) = 6) t
